name: cinematic-ui
description: Direct a website the way a film is made: cast a director and a film, choose the medium the film calls for (photoreal 3D, hand-drawn, ink wash, print, pixel, neon, type, photography…), cast a lead, ask for the assets, write a shot list for every section, then shoot it with a scroll-driven camera, designed cuts, a grade, and a screening pass on rendered frames. Use for Awwwards / Framer-grade landing pages, brand, product, portfolio and studio sites, immersive or WebGL / 3D sites, scrollytelling, "cinematic", "film style", "director style", "電影感", "導演風格", "分鏡", "像拍電影一樣做網站", a director's colour or film look (retro / nostalgic, film grain, neon / futuristic, "復古懷舊", "霓虹", "調色", "美術風格", "海報風格"), premium non-template design. Also directs apps in app mode: dashboards, back offices, admin panels, consoles, internal tools and the signed-in side of a SaaS product ("後台", "管理後台", "儀表板", "控制台", "面板", "dashboard", "admin").
